scheme_name: The Artist Welfare Fund Of Assam
description:
The Artist Welfare Fund of Assam was established in 2021. 

It was created to support artists and cultural practitioners in the state of Assam. 

The initiative aims to provide financial assistance to artists who face hardships due to various circumstances. 

The fund is particularly focused on those who have made significant contributions to the cultural landscape of Assam. 

The primary objective of the Artist Welfare Fund is to ensure the welfare and upliftment of artists. 

The scheme targets artists from various disciplines including music, dance, drama, and visual arts. 

One of the measurable targets of the fund is to provide immediate financial relief to artists in distress. 

The fund aims to assist at least 1,000 artists annually. 

The assistance provided under this scheme can go up to INR 50,000 per artist. 

This financial support is intended for artists who are unable to sustain themselves due to health issues or other personal crises. 

The eligibility criteria for the Artist Welfare Fund are clearly defined. 

Artists must be residents of Assam. 

They should have a proven track record in their respective art forms. 

Applicants must be at least 18 years old to qualify for the fund. 

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility. 

Income criteria are also established for applicants. 

Artists with an annual income of less than INR 2,00,000 are eligible to apply. 

This income limit ensures that the fund reaches those who are truly in need. 

The application process for the Artist Welfare Fund is straightforward. 

Interested artists must fill out an application form available on the official website of the Assam Government. 

The application form requires personal details including name, address, and contact information. 

Applicants must also provide details about their art form and contributions to the cultural sector. 

A declaration of income is required to verify eligibility. 

Supporting documents must be submitted along with the application. 

These documents include proof of residence, income certificate, and any certificates or awards related to their art form. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes a verification process. 

The verification is conducted by the Department of Cultural Affairs, Assam. 

The department evaluates the applications based on the eligibility criteria. 

Successful applicants receive financial assistance directly into their bank accounts. 

The disbursement of funds is typically processed within 30 days of approval. 

The fund is disbursed on a rolling basis throughout the year. 

There are no specific deadlines for application submissions. 

This allows artists to apply whenever they face financial difficulties. 

The Artist Welfare Fund is managed by the Government of Assam. 

The Department of Cultural Affairs is the primary implementing authority. 

For any inquiries or assistance, artists can contact the Department of Cultural Affairs. 

The contact details are available on the official Assam Government website. 

The fund has been instrumental in providing support to many artists since its inception. 

As of 2023, over 500 artists have benefited from the fund. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 5 crore for the fund in the fiscal year 2023-2024. 

This allocation aims to enhance the reach and impact of the fund. 

The fund also aims to promote cultural heritage and traditional art forms. 

By supporting artists, the government seeks to preserve Assam's rich cultural identity. 

The fund is part of a broader initiative to promote the arts in Assam. 

It complements other schemes aimed at cultural development in the state. 

The government encourages artists to apply for the fund whenever they face hardships. 

The Artist Welfare Fund has received positive feedback from the artistic community. 

Many artists have expressed gratitude for the timely support provided by the fund. 

The fund is seen as a lifeline for many struggling artists in Assam. 

It reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of its cultural practitioners. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing needs of the artistic community. 

Future enhancements may include increased financial support or additional benefits. 

The government is open to suggestions from artists to improve the fund. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the fund's effectiveness. 

The Artist Welfare Fund is a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of artists. 

It aims to create a sustainable ecosystem for the arts in Assam. 

The fund is a testament to the importance of culture in society. 

By supporting artists, the government aims to foster creativity and innovation. 

This initiative is part of a larger vision to promote cultural tourism in Assam. 

The government believes that supporting artists will attract more visitors to the state. 

Overall, the Artist Welfare Fund of Assam represents a crucial support system for artists. 

It is designed to ensure that those who enrich the cultural fabric of society are not left behind. 

The fund stands as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

It highlights the importance of government support in the arts sector. 

The fund is a vital resource for artists facing financial challenges. 

It serves as a reminder of the value of cultural contributions to society. 

The Artist Welfare Fund is an essential initiative for the preservation of Assam's artistic heritage. 

It aims to empower artists and ensure their livelihoods are secure. 

The fund is a beacon of hope for many in the artistic community. 

It underscores the government's role in nurturing and supporting the arts.
